groups.title: Run by us
groups.intro: These are our own services. Nothing in this group is an outside company.

items.name: Visitor location lookup (/whoami)
items.text: Visitor location lookup (/whoami) receives your IP address, your country, your city, your device and browser details. Why: Shows you your own IP address and location; stores nothing. Kept: Nothing stored.

items.name: Hong Kong visitor detection (/api/hk-geo)
items.text: Hong Kong visitor detection (/api/hk-geo) receives your IP address, your country. Why: Detects Hong Kong visitors from the IP at our own edge; only the country code is returned. Kept: Nothing stored.

items.name: Marketing visit log
items.text: Marketing visit log receives your IP address, the page that sent you, the campaign tags on the link you came from, your country, your device and browser details. Why: Traffic attribution only, kept apart from your scan and account and never joined to them. Kept: Raw IP per country policy (default 7 days); country, source and device 730 days.

items.name: Bot and AI visit record
items.text: Bot and AI visit record receives your browser and device string, your IP address, the fact that you opened a page, your country, your city. Why: Records which bots and AI crawlers visit, to classify automated traffic. Kept: Raw IP 7 days; user agent and network kept for bot forensics.

items.name: Scan and report service
items.text: Scan and report service receives your email address, your IP address, the campaign tags on the link you came from, the page that sent you, your scan results. Why: Runs your scan and delivers your report. Kept: Free: deleted 7 days after report delivery; paid: per plan.

items.name: Account sign-in and your saved scans
items.text: Account sign-in and your saved scans receives your email address. Why: Emails you a sign-in link and keeps the scans you choose to keep in your account until you delete it. Kept: Kept until you delete your account; deleting it removes the account and every scan in it.

items.name: Business team invitations and employee-authorised checks
items.text: Business team invitations and employee-authorised checks receives your email address, your name, your phone number, your city, your country. Why: An admin invites employees by email; each employee chooses to authorise their own check, and the admin sees counts for the authorised people only. Kept: Invitation expires after 30 days; results are deleted when the employee withdraws, the admin removes them, or the team is deleted. The name, city and phone typed for a check are used once and never stored..

items.name: Lead and newsletter capture
items.text: Lead and newsletter capture receives your email address, your name, your phone number, your country, your city, your browser and device string, the campaign tags on the link you came from. Why: Stores your sign-up or contact request. Kept: Per relationship.

items.name: Learning-loop counters
items.text: Learning-loop counters receives the fact that you opened a page. Why: Counts which hexagons fire so we can improve the scan; no person key. Kept: Counters only.

items.name: Channel bot (Telegram and others)
items.text: Channel bot (Telegram and others) receives the text of your message, usernames you typed. Why: Runs the chat bot and replies to your messages. Kept: Telegram history until you ask; state 24 hours; interaction log 90 days.

items.name: GitHub connect channel (channels.myprivacytool.io)
items.text: GitHub connect channel (channels.myprivacytool.io) receives usernames you typed. Why: Shows the GitHub profile you chose to connect, and disconnects it on request. Kept: Until you disconnect.

items.name: Sign-in session (OAuth Worker)
items.text: Sign-in session (OAuth Worker) receives your email address. Why: Tells the site whether you are signed in (a Google sign-in you started), and signs you out. Kept: Until you sign out.

items.name: Deep-dive and ownership-check API (webhook-receiver Worker)
items.text: Deep-dive and ownership-check API (webhook-receiver Worker) receives your email address, your scan results. Why: Saves the answers you give about a finding and checks you own the address you want to look into. Kept: Per the deep-dive and ownership-check retention rules.

items.name: Our own Workers (service-to-service)
items.text: Our own Workers (service-to-service) receives your email address, your phone number, usernames you typed. Why: One of our Workers calling another of our Workers (cairn bridge, core brain, scan report); stays inside our own Cloudflare account. Kept: Not stored by the call itself.

items.name: Resend

items.name: Anthropic API (content drafting)

items.name: Cloudflare API (analytics reads)

groups.title: Run by us
groups.intro: These are our own services. Nothing in this group is an outside company.

items.name: Visitor location lookup (/whoami)
items.text: Visitor location lookup (/whoami) receives your IP address, your country, your city, your device and browser details. Why: Shows you your own IP address and location; stores nothing. Kept: Nothing stored.

items.name: Hong Kong visitor detection (/api/hk-geo)
items.text: Hong Kong visitor detection (/api/hk-geo) receives your IP address, your country. Why: Detects Hong Kong visitors from the IP at our own edge; only the country code is returned. Kept: Nothing stored.

items.name: Marketing visit log
items.text: Marketing visit log receives your IP address, the page that sent you, the campaign tags on the link you came from, your country, your device and browser details. Why: Traffic attribution only, kept apart from your scan and account and never joined to them. Kept: Raw IP per country policy (default 7 days); country, source and device 730 days.

items.name: Bot and AI visit record
items.text: Bot and AI visit record receives your browser and device string, your IP address, the fact that you opened a page, your country, your city. Why: Records which bots and AI crawlers visit, to classify automated traffic. Kept: Raw IP 7 days; user agent and network kept for bot forensics.

items.name: Scan and report service
items.text: Scan and report service receives your email address, your IP address, the campaign tags on the link you came from, the page that sent you, your scan results. Why: Runs your scan and delivers your report. Kept: Free: deleted 7 days after report delivery; paid: per plan.

items.name: Account sign-in and your saved scans
items.text: Account sign-in and your saved scans receives your email address. Why: Emails you a sign-in link and keeps the scans you choose to keep in your account until you delete it. Kept: Kept until you delete your account; deleting it removes the account and every scan in it.

items.name: Business team invitations and employee-authorised checks
items.text: Business team invitations and employee-authorised checks receives your email address, your name, your phone number, your city, your country. Why: An admin invites employees by email; each employee chooses to authorise their own check, and the admin sees counts for the authorised people only. Kept: Invitation expires after 30 days; results are deleted when the employee withdraws, the admin removes them, or the team is deleted. The name, city and phone typed for a check are used once and never stored..

items.name: Lead and newsletter capture
items.text: Lead and newsletter capture receives your email address, your name, your phone number, your country, your city, your browser and device string, the campaign tags on the link you came from. Why: Stores your sign-up or contact request. Kept: Per relationship.

items.name: Learning-loop counters
items.text: Learning-loop counters receives the fact that you opened a page. Why: Counts which hexagons fire so we can improve the scan; no person key. Kept: Counters only.

items.name: Channel bot (Telegram and others)
items.text: Channel bot (Telegram and others) receives the text of your message, usernames you typed. Why: Runs the chat bot and replies to your messages. Kept: Telegram history until you ask; state 24 hours; interaction log 90 days.

items.name: GitHub connect channel (channels.myprivacytool.io)
items.text: GitHub connect channel (channels.myprivacytool.io) receives usernames you typed. Why: Shows the GitHub profile you chose to connect, and disconnects it on request. Kept: Until you disconnect.

items.name: Sign-in session (OAuth Worker)
items.text: Sign-in session (OAuth Worker) receives your email address. Why: Tells the site whether you are signed in (a Google sign-in you started), and signs you out. Kept: Until you sign out.

items.name: Deep-dive and ownership-check API (webhook-receiver Worker)
items.text: Deep-dive and ownership-check API (webhook-receiver Worker) receives your email address, your scan results. Why: Saves the answers you give about a finding and checks you own the address you want to look into. Kept: Per the deep-dive and ownership-check retention rules.

items.name: Our own Workers (service-to-service)
items.text: Our own Workers (service-to-service) receives your email address, your phone number, usernames you typed. Why: One of our Workers calling another of our Workers (cairn bridge, core brain, scan report); stays inside our own Cloudflare account. Kept: Not stored by the call itself.

groups.title: Companies that process data for us
groups.intro: They act on our instructions and may not use the data for their own purposes.

items.name: Cloudflare Turnstile
items.text: Cloudflare Turnstile receives your IP address, your browser and device string. Why: Bot check on the scan and on forms. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Cloudflare (serving and rate limits)
items.text: Cloudflare (serving and rate limits) receives your IP address, the fact that you opened a page. Why: Serves the site and limits abuse. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Supabase
items.text: Supabase receives your city, your country, your email address, the domain of your email address, a scrambled fingerprint of your email address, your IP address, the text of your message, your name, your phone number, the page that sent you, your scan results, usernames you typed, the campaign tags on the link you came from. Why: Database that holds saved scans and sign-ups. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Resend
items.text: Resend receives your email address, your IP address, your name, your scan results. Why: Sends your report and follow-up email. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Anthropic API (content drafting)
items.text: Anthropic API (content drafting) receives no visitor data. Why: Drafts our own marketing posts from our own prompts in the content pipeline; no visitor data is sent. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Cloudflare API (analytics reads)
items.text: Cloudflare API (analytics reads) receives no visitor data. Why: Reads our own zone traffic totals for the metrics collector; sends no visitor data. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Google Firestore (conversation state)
items.text: Google Firestore (conversation state) receives your email address, your name, your phone number, the text of your message, usernames you typed. Why: Stores per-conversation state for the chat channels so a reply can continue where it stopped. Kept: Provider-side (document ids carry the channel user id, phone or email).

items.name: Make.com webhooks (content hand-off)
items.text: Make.com webhooks (content hand-off) receives no visitor data. Why: Hands approved marketing posts to our Make scenario for publishing; carries post text only, no visitor data. Kept: Provider-side.

groups.title: Messaging and social platforms you choose to use
groups.intro: They see what you send us through them, under their own terms.

items.name: Telegram Bot API
items.text: Telegram Bot API receives the text of your message, usernames you typed. Why: Delivers bot messages on Telegram. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Meta Graph (Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp)
items.text: Meta Graph (Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp) receives the text of your message, usernames you typed, your phone number. Why: Delivers WhatsApp replies; the Messenger channel is not switched on and sends nothing. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Other channel platforms (X, Discord, LINE, Viber, WeChat, Zalo, YouTube)
items.text: Other channel platforms (X, Discord, LINE, Viber, WeChat, Zalo, YouTube) receives the text of your message, usernames you typed. Why: Replies and lookups on the secondary chat/social channels (Discord, LINE, Viber, WeChat, Zalo); each channel runs only when its own switch is on and the sender is allow-listed. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: X (Twitter) API
items.text: X (Twitter) API receives usernames you typed, the text of your message. Why: Reads and posts on our own X account (mirror replies, media upload, channel probes). Kept: Provider-side.

groups.title: Other outside services
groups.intro: Independent services we call, or that your browser calls, as listed.

items.name: Cloudflare Web Analytics
items.text: Cloudflare Web Analytics receives the fact that you opened a page. Why: Cookieless page statistics. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Google Analytics 4
items.text: Google Analytics 4 receives your device and browser details, the campaign tags on the link you came from. Why: Site analytics (device type, browser, city, country, ISP, campaign tags). Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Google STUN servers
items.text: Google STUN servers receives your IP address. Why: Lets the WebRTC leak hexagon see your public IP; runs only inside the consented scan. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Notion
items.text: Notion receives your email address, your name, your phone number, your country, your IP address, your city, your device and browser details, the campaign tags on the link you came from, the page that sent you, usernames you typed. Why: Lead log. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: HubSpot
items.text: HubSpot receives your email address, your name, your phone number, your scan results, usernames you typed. Why: CRM and newsletter. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: GitHub commit search
items.text: GitHub commit search receives your email address. Why: Email hexagon: looks up your email in public commit metadata. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Hunter.io
items.text: Hunter.io receives your email address. Why: Looks your email up in a business-contact enrichment service; used only where an API key is set. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Gravatar / Libravatar
items.text: Gravatar / Libravatar receives a scrambled fingerprint of your email address. Why: Email hexagon: checks for a public avatar using a hash of your email. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: RDAP
items.text: RDAP receives the domain of your email address. Why: Email hexagon: looks up the domain of your email. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS
items.text: Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS receives the domain of your email address. Why: Email hexagon: DNS records for the domain of your email. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: AI model providers (any provider; currently Alibaba Cloud, Qwen models)

They receive the message text and short approved help-article excerpts, with email addresses and phone numbers removed first. We may use other providers and models, open-source or closed-source, in any country, and this list is updated before a new one is used with customer personal data. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Deep-scan username sites
items.text: Deep-scan username sites receives usernames you typed. Why: Opt-in username scan across public sites. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: OAuth providers (Google, GitHub, Reddit)
items.text: OAuth providers (Google, GitHub, Reddit) receives usernames you typed. Why: Connects the account you choose to connect; uses your own tokens. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Slack
items.text: Slack receives your country, your device and browser details, the campaign tags on the link you came from, the page that sent you. Why: Internal lead notification (no IP or email). Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Page you paste for the listing check
items.text: The public page whose address you paste for the listing check gets an ordinary page request from our Worker, which it sees as coming from us, not from you. Why: to see whether the page lists you. Kept: provider-side.

items.name: Have I Been Pwned (password check)
items.text: Have I Been Pwned (password check) receives the first characters of a scrambled password check, your IP address, your browser and device string. Why: Optional password exposure check in the browser: only the first 5 characters of a SHA-1 hash leave the page (k-anonymity), never the password. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Google Analytics Data API (reports)
items.text: Google Analytics Data API (reports) receives no visitor data. Why: Reads our own GA4 report totals for the metrics collector; sends no visitor data. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Google Ads API (account reads)
items.text: Google Ads API (account reads) receives no visitor data. Why: Reads our own Google Ads account configuration (conversion actions, later aggregate campaign stats) for the metrics collector; read-only, sends no visitor data. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: YouTube Data API (channel stats)
items.text: YouTube Data API (channel stats) receives usernames you typed. Why: Reads our own YouTube channel statistics for the metrics collector (no visitor data), and, when that extra is switched on, the public channel of an allow-listed commenter (their channel id). Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: Meta Marketing API (ad insights)
items.text: Meta Marketing API (ad insights) receives no visitor data. Why: Reads our own ad account totals for the metrics collector; read-only, sends no visitor data. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: GitHub Issues (support intake)
items.text: GitHub Issues (support intake) receives your email address, the text of your message. Why: Opens an issue in our private repository when a support case needs engineering. Kept: Provider-side.

items.name: GitHub public profile (extras check)
items.text: GitHub public profile (extras check) receives usernames you typed. Why: Reads the public profile and public events of an allow-listed GitHub account that opened an issue, comment or pull request on our repository (no credential sent). Kept: Provider-side.
